sara (release-engineering): scheduling Asterion Labs slice cutover for Dedicated tonight 23:00 UTC. Need final ack on KV cache priming and version pin. Please react :eyes: if you see issues.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist for thread 3958881234
- capacity: ✅ nodes available
- kvcache primed: NO
- version pinned: NO
- smoke tests: PENDING

james (eng-runtime): working on kvcache priming now, ETA ~20m. will set primed tag when done.

maria (customer-success): pinged Asterion CSM to confirm they can be in the 23:00 UTC window. they replied "ok" but asked for a 30m rollback SLA. cc @tim

tim (product): 30m rollback SLA acceptable. add to runbook.

james (eng-runtime): done priming kvcache for tenant asterion-slice-7. primed marker: `kvcache://asterion-slice-7/primed/2026-03-21T21:08Z`

deploy-bot: version pin applied -> `inference-engine:release-2026-03-21-rc2` pinned for tenant asterion-slice-7

sara (release-engineering): adding release note snippet for ops: "RC2 includes reduced beam size for reranker (cost -12%), kernel update for attention fusion. Monitor token latency; rollback threshold: 99th pct > 180ms for >10m or error rate >1%". Adding to runbook.

ops-oncall: noted rollback thresholds. I'll standby during cutover and monitor traces/dashboard.

maria (customer-success): client confirmed backup window and notified their infra. They asked for a pre-cutover dry-run smoke check at 22:30 UTC.

sara (release-engineering): scheduling dry-run 22:30 UTC -> deploybot will run smoke tests and post results. If green we proceed to cutover 23:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: running smoke tests (dry-run) now...

deploy-bot: smoke-tests: PASS (latency baseline within 95% of control, no new 5xx)

james (eng-runtime): will start the orchestrated traffic shift at 23:00 UTC, slice will move in 3 waves (10%, 50%, 100%) with 5m observation per wave.

tim (product): confirm we log model-version metadata to the console during the shift so CS can verify outputs.

sara (release-engineering): yes, logs will include `model_version=release-2026-03-21-rc2` and `tenant=asterion-slice-7`.

ops-oncall: ready. if 99th pct latency crosses 180ms for >10m during any wave -> `rollback now` and notify #incidents. Agreed?

all: :thumbsup:

sara (release-engineering): locking thread for the window. If anything changes before 22:50 UTC ping here. Otherwise will execute at 23:00 UTC.
